stem.text: A steam turbine is used to drive a generator. The input power to the turbine is $P_\text{I}$ and the output power is $P_\text{O}$. The power loss in the turbine is $P_\text{L}$, as shown.

stem.alt: Flow diagram: an arrow labelled input power P_I enters a box labelled turbine. A downward arrow from the turbine is labelled power loss P_L. A second arrow labelled output power P_O leaves the turbine and enters a box labelled generator.
